card: Adds test coverage for the package-level replacement conflict limit in package RBF. Previously, tests for replacement conflict limits triggered the limit on the parent alone, leaving the aggregate package conflict check in PackageRBFChecks unexercised. The author demonstrates that existing tests pass even if the aggregate check is disabled in validation.cpp.
evidence: PR description points out a mutation test (mutanthub.space/mutants/4673) where disabling the `GetEntriesForConflicts` check in `MemPoolAccept::PackageRBFChecks` passes all existing tests.
Commit message: 'The existing max-conflict cases fail on the parent alone, so the package-level conflict limit check in PackageRBFChecks never runs.'
problem: Existing package RBF conflict tests trigger the conflict limit on the parent transaction alone, meaning the package-wide aggregate limit check in `PackageRBFChecks` is never exercised by the test suite.

risk.why: A flaw in this test could lead to false test failures or inaccurate test coverage for package RBF validation without affecting production code.

summary: Adds a test case covering the package-level replacement conflict limit check in package RBF. It constructs a package with a zero-fee parent and a child that together exceed the maximum replacement conflict limit, ensuring the aggregate limit check is exercised rather than failing early on the parent alone.
